player_prompt.intro:
O kerekere mo Player {player_id} ena qito vaka-Indian Poker.
- 52-na kadi; o raica ga na kadi nei opponent.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ena kila raundi, {max_rounds} raundi(s) taucoko.
- Vakayagataki dina: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X e integer dodonu ≤ nomu chip count.)
- Kadi cecere duadua e wini na pot ena showdown.

round.announce:
### Raundi {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Na kadi nei opponent oqo: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Solia ga e dua na vakayagataki bracketed, vaka. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', se '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Sega ni rawa [check] - o sa sotava tiko e dua na veimauilavo.
invalid_move.amount_min: Na levu ni ilavo e vakacurumi/rawaitaki me ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Sega ni dua na ka mo kacivaka; o rawa ga [check].
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Vakayagataka na [bet X] me dolavi; e sega ni dua na bet mo laveta.
invalid_move.insufficient: E sega ni veirauti na ilavo me caka kina.

board.possible_actions: Na ka o rawa ni cakava: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Na isau ni qito: ruarua {card}. Wasei na bilo  yadua e ciqoma {split} .

outcome.draw: Na chips tautauvata ni oti kece na veivoli
